settings.heading:
REFILLS,
ON time.
settings.text: Bristles wear out. Floss picks run low. Instead of remembering to reorder, we send replacements on the schedule that fits your routine.

settings.title: Brush head or toothbrush
settings.text: Electric Kit refills contain one replacement brush head. Manual Kit refills contain one replacement toothbrush.

settings.title: Floss Heads × 90
settings.text: Ninety replacement heads, one for each day, for your angled floss handle.

settings.title: Tuft Brush Heads × 4
settings.text: Tuft heads wear faster than a toothbrush, swap one roughly every three weeks. Four covers your cycle. The handle stays with you.

settings.title: Tongue Brush
settings.text: Bristles flatten with use and stop lifting the coating properly. You replace the whole tool every 90 days, a fresh tongue brush in every box.

settings.heading:
WHAT'S IN A
refill BOX.
settings.intro: Just the parts that wear out. Your case, handles and stainless steel tongue scraper are built to stay with you.
settings.footnote: Your refill is matched to the kit you own. Refills can be bought as a one-off or on subscription, subscription is cheaper and includes free UK delivery.

settings.description: Every 90 days, the interval dentists recommend for replacing a brush head.

settings.heading:
EVERY
ninety DAYS.
settings.footnote: Pause anytime. Skip a delivery from your account. Cancel whenever you like. No calls, no forms.
settings.quote:
"You don't want to think about oral care.
So we think about it for you."
